findings.title: expand_file bakes original leading indentation into placeholder and omits :* in fuzzy matching, corrupting files and .bak when /code-simplify re-indents or edits reason text
findings.detail: In hooks/simplify-ignore.sh:84 and 170-196, filter_file stores the full line prefix before simplify-ignore-start (including leading whitespace) in .prefix.<hash>. When /code-simplify flattens a nested block (e.g. unindenting a placeholder from 4 spaces to 2 spaces), neither esc_placeholder nor esc_fuzzy matches because both require the original 4-space prefix. expand_file falls through to line=${line//BLOCK_${h}/$block_content} (line 193), replacing only the bare BLOCK_<hash> token and leaving the comment opener before the expanded block and : <reason> */ after simplify-ignore-end. During PostToolUse Edit|Write (line 424), this corrupted syntax overwrites $CACHE/${ID}.bak. The same fallback failure hits any /* ... */ or <!-- ... --> block whose reason text was modified by the model, because esc_fuzzy (${bp}BLOCK_${h}${bs}) omits :* between BLOCK_${h} and ${bs}, and in // or # comments ${bp}BLOCK_${h} matches only the prefix+hash and leaves : <modified-reason> appended to simplify-ignore-end.
findings.recommendation: In hooks/simplify-ignore.sh:170-196, match re-indented placeholders by stripping leading whitespace from bp (${bp#"${bp%%[![:space:]]*}"}) and pairing with the current line indentation, update the fuzzy fallback to match ${esc_bp}BLOCK_${h}:*${esc_bs} (or ${esc_bp}BLOCK_${h}:* when bs is empty) before ${esc_bp}BLOCK_${h}${esc_bs}, and add regression Tests 19-21 in hooks/simplify-ignore-test.sh.

findings.title: Stop loop aborts under set -euo pipefail when .lock directory is missing, and parse_error on malformed JSON falls through into Stop and wipes active backups
findings.detail: hooks/simplify-ignore.sh enables set -euo pipefail at line 17, but calls rmdir "$CACHE/${fid}.lock" 2>/dev/null without || true at lines 326, 332, 339, and 392 (unlike line 373 which uses || true). If a lock directory is missing when Stop iterates over multiple .bak files, rmdir returns exit code 1 on the first file and aborts the script before restoring remaining files. In addition, when jq fails to parse malformed hook input at lines 37-47, parse_error is logged with TOOL_NAME="" but execution does not exit, falling straight into if [ -z "$TOOL_NAME" ] at line 287 (the Stop handler) and wiping active session backups mid-session.
findings.recommendation: Exit 0 after logging parse_error at hooks/simplify-ignore.sh:47, append || true to rmdir calls at lines 326, 332, 339, and 392, and add regression coverage in hooks/simplify-ignore-test.sh.

findings.title: expand_file calls grep -qF without -- on first_line, emitting a false block-deleted warning on SQL/Lua/Haskell -- simplify-ignore-start comments
findings.detail: At hooks/simplify-ignore.sh:213-216, expand_file checks whether a block was expanded by running grep -qF "$first_line" "$dest" 2>/dev/null without -- (unlike lines 265 and 363 which pass --). When a protected block uses double-dash comments (-- simplify-ignore-start in SQL, Lua, Haskell, or Ada), grep interprets $first_line as an unrecognized long option, exits 2, and prints a false Warning: protected block BLOCK_<hash> was deleted by model on every Edit, Write, and Stop.
findings.recommendation: Pass -- to grep -qF in hooks/simplify-ignore.sh:213 and 216.

findings.title: sdd-cache-pre.sh stderr payload emission could interpret format specifiers or backticks in cached documentation bodies
findings.detail: hooks/sdd-cache-pre.sh:94-105 writes the cached WebFetch body ($CONTENT) to stderr on HTTP 304 hits; if $CONTENT is passed as a printf format string or unquoted heredoc, % specifiers or $(...) in docs could corrupt output or execute.
findings.recommendation: Verify whether printf in hooks/sdd-cache-pre.sh:103 passes %s as the format string and whether hooks/sdd-cache-test.sh tests shell-hostile content.

findings.title: sdd-cache-post.sh strips CR before AWK paragraph splitting and writes cache files atomically via temp file rename
findings.detail: hooks/sdd-cache-post.sh:82-133 strips \r from curl -sI -L output so AWK paragraph mode isolates the final redirect hop headers, and writes .claude/sdd-cache/<sha>.json atomically via ${CACHE_FILE}.$$.tmp + mv.

findings.title: session-start.sh emits a valid SessionStart hookSpecificOutput JSON envelope on all code paths
findings.detail: hooks/session-start.sh:18-33 uses jq -cn --arg context when jq is available and falls back to static valid JSON envelopes when jq or SKILL.md is missing.

findings.title: sdd-cache-pre.sh safely emits cached WebFetch content via printf %s without shell or format expansion
findings.detail: hooks/sdd-cache-pre.sh:91-105 validates ETag/Last-Modified via HTTP 304 and writes $CONTENT with printf "%s\n" "$CONTENT" >&2, preventing command substitution and format-string interpretation.

findings.title: skill-lint.js enforces CommonMark fence stripping and strict YAML frontmatter rules without external dependencies
findings.detail: scripts/lib/skill-lint.js:129-156 and 229-322 accurately strip backtick and tilde fences of variable length and catch unquoted colons, tabs, and indicator characters that break host YAML parsers.
